subject: Post-demo compliance checklist & request for SOC 2 Type II / portal access
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo compliance checklist & request for SOC 2 Type II / portal access

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Great conversation and appreciate the level of detail on NovaPulse's ingestion and retention requirements. Per our alignment on the call, next steps from a compliance standpoint: 

- We will share our SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and an interim bridge letter to cover the period since the audit.
- We can provision a read-only account for your security team on our Trust Portal so you can pull the report and artifact indexes directly.
- If you prefer, we can kick off the vendor DDQ (we’ve attached our standard questions so your team can see scope).

Can you confirm the right recipients on your side for portal access (security person + procurement)? Also let us know if HIPAA or data residency concerns are top of mind — I flagged GDPR/HIPAA on the call but want to be explicit.

Deliverables and rough timing: SOC 2 docs + bridge letter (within 2 business days once I confirm with security), trust portal invite (same day as docs), vendor DDQ (we can send a canned questionnaire or a spreadsheet for you to fill).

Looping in Marissa from our compliance team and Ben from sales ops to coordinate the portal invite and attachments.

Best,
Marcus
Director of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: vendor_ddq_questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Marcus —

Thanks, this is helpful. For NovaPulse the security reviewer is Julian Kim (julian.kim@novapulse.com) and procurement is procurement@novapulse.com. Please include Julian on any portal invites.

A few asks from our side: 
- Can you provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II PDF and an official bridge letter for the gap to present? We need both for internal intake.
- If you have a summary of controls relevant to data residency and HIPAA controls (a short bulleted matrix), that will speed our review.
- We'll complete the DDQ but FYI procurement will route contract terms only after we validate the controls.

Ideally we need the docs by end of day Monday (24 Aug).

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Manager, IT Risk & Compliance
Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novapulse.com>

Hi Lena / Julian (cc),

Marissa here from Redwood's security & compliance team. Marcus copied me to coordinate the artifacts. Per Marcus’ note I’m attaching the bridge letter template and the vendor DDQ workbook for your team.

What I’m sending now:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_report_202504.pdf (will place in Trust Portal; redacted summary available on request)
- redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf (attached — editable; we’ll sign and return the final)
- vendor_ddq_questions_v1.xlsx (carries the standard controls we typically see requested)

A couple of clarifications: 
- The SOC 2 Type II report covers security and availability; we also maintain documented controls for HIPAA handling and a mapping to relevant procedures. If you want the HIPAA-specific control mapping I can generate a one-page matrix.
- Trust Portal access: I’ll provision a read-only account for Julian and procurement with the following URL: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite/NP-4589. You’ll get a separate email with credentials; please check spam in case your org blocks automated invites.

Next steps / timeline:
1) I’ll upload the report and bridge letter to the portal by EOD today (24 Aug).
2) Once Julian confirms portal access I’ll finalize and sign the bridge letter (we aim to send signed PDF within 24 hours of access confirmation).
3) If you return the completed DDQ, we’ll respond with evidence pointers and artifact IDs.

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf (pdf), vendor_ddq_questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

If you prefer a short screen-share we can walk through the portal and artifact index — Marcus can schedule.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
